### Today’s NFL injury briefing

**Biggest status changes**
- **49ers CB Nate Hobbs**: Suffered a **groin injury** during joint practices/against the Titans and is expected to **miss multiple weeks**.  
  - **Why it matters:** San Francisco loses a cornerback option for at least the near term.
  - **Watch next:** Exact timeline as the team updates his recovery.

- **49ers QB Kurtis Rourke**: **Rib injury**; stadium X-rays showed **no fracture**, but he went to a local hospital for more imaging after having trouble catching his breath. Kyle Shanahan said he’s “not too concerned,” but didn’t downplay it.  
  - **Why it matters:** The issue is not confirmed serious, but it’s still an active evaluation.
  - **Watch next:** Results of the additional imaging.

- **Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson**: Left practice with an injury and **didn’t return**.  
  - **Why it matters:** Any missed time could slow a rookie receiver’s rollout.
  - **Watch next:** Which body part was affected and whether the team offers a timetable.

**Other notable injuries**
- **Cardinals G Chase Bistonis**: Suffered a **knee injury**; the report’s severity detail was incomplete.  
- **Colts ST coordinator Brian Mason**: Suffered a **knee injury** on the final play of the preseason opener and was taken off the sideline.  
- **Texans note**: A team video referenced **Graham Mertz’s ACL injury** and an **MRI on Friday**; no further details were provided.

**Returning from injury / positive recovery note**
- **Jordan Watkins**: Had a **high ankle sprain** in last preseason, but is now back in a better place physically after adding muscle and trimming body fat. He’s working primarily in **Ricky Pearsall’s Z receiver spot**.  
  - **Why it matters:** A healthy Watkins could factor into the receiver rotation.
  - **Watch next:** Whether he keeps earning reps in that role.
